# implement-spec ledger — P16.1 Contributor system

- **spec:** docs/tickets/P16.1__contributors.md (→ docs/2_canonical_design_spec.md §34.1–34.4, §16.6)
- **base commit:** 2b361f18e4b1b964a84fe466b6ef8a737d988acd
- **branch:** devin/p16-1-contributors
- **base branch:** devin/p15-5-corrections-methodology (stacked)
- **Docker:** available → tests/db suite runs.

## Conventions learned (Phase 0.3)
- uv workspace; `make check` = lint(ruff) + format-check + typecheck(mypy strict) + pytest + verify-gen.
- tasks/ package: pure in-memory Python engine (StrEnum vocab, frozen dataclasses), data in TOML via `_data.load_table`. Tests under tests/tasks/ named test_tasks_*.py; no DB.
- Claim spine (P02.1) in db/: append-only; correction = close sys_period + insert new claim with revises_claim/retraction_of + correction_reason. `retraction_of` column already exists; no code inserts it yet. DB tests under tests/db/ (testcontainers PG18+PostGIS + sqitch).
- policy.governance.BeliefLog is the established in-memory append-only model mirroring the claim spine — the pattern to mirror for revert-as-new-assertion.
- Governance prose in docs/governance/ (contributor-safety.md already covers 005–008); ADRs in docs/adr/ (need "## Revisit trigger"); traceability in docs/traceability.md (per-phase tables Requirement|Where|Test); risk register docs/risk_register.md.
- SPDX header on every source file (Apache-2.0 block, see any tasks/*.py).
- Person creation gated below Curator (spec Notes; §11.3/§43.4 enforce upstream).

## Requirements (in scope) → plan
- SIG-CONTRIB-001 five-tier write model (scope + review req) → tasks/contributor.py
- SIG-CONTRIB-002 no claim without provenance; submissions enter L0 as evidence, never L1 → tasks/contributor.py + tasks/submission.py (AC1)
- SIG-CONTRIB-003 onboarding paths + moderated usability study (≥5 naïve, median ≤10 min, published) → tasks/onboarding.py + docs/governance/contributor-onboarding-usability-study.md + data toml (AC7 agentic)
- SIG-CONTRIB-004 device observations routed to OSM/DeFlock (not captured) → tasks/submission.py
- SIG-CONTRIB-005 no PII retention (no real-name/device-id/precise-geo cols; IP/op logs purge past window) → tasks/submission.py (safety records + purge) (AC2)
- SIG-CONTRIB-006 pseudonymous at every tier incl trusted-reviewer → tasks/contributor.py (AC3)
- SIG-CONTRIB-009 revert as a unit, new append-only assertion, deletes nothing → tasks/revert.py + DB test (AC4)
- SIG-CONTRIB-010 anomaly detection (bursts/coordinated/contested-resolving) routes to review not auto-reject → tasks/poisoning.py (AC5)
- SIG-CONTRIB-011 false-absence guarded equally → tasks/poisoning.py (AC5)
- SIG-CONTRIB-011a vendor operating-territory check: lowest confidence + verification task → tasks/poisoning.py (AC6)
- SIG-CONTRIB-011b no SIG-caused mass revert (suggestion-not-write) → tasks/poisoning.py
- SIG-CONTRIB-011c unverified community obs not same visual weight as records-derived → tasks/poisoning.py

## Out of scope (confirm NOT implemented)
- Contribution-back (OSM suggestion workflow, Organised Editing, changeset hashtag, licence gate, upstream attribution) — P16.2 (SIG-CONTRIB-012..020).
- Anomaly ML beyond §34.4 pattern rules; the review queue itself (P05.2).

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] AC1 submission → L0 evidence artifact, no L1 claim (002)
- [ ] AC2 no PII cols; op logs purge past window (005)
- [ ] AC3 pseudonymous per tier incl trusted reviewer (006)
- [ ] AC4 revert = new append-only assertion, deletes nothing (009)
- [ ] AC5 anomaly routes bursts/coordinated/contested-resolving to review; false-absence equal (010/011)
- [ ] AC6 vendor territory: no independent V-in-C → lowest confidence + verification task (011a)
- [ ] AC7 usability study ≥5 naïve, protocol+results published, median ≤10 min (003) [agentic]
- [ ] AC8 phase-gate: CI green; new reqs tested; ADR for deviation; traceability + risk register updated
